response.overview: The Hunger Games (but better) is a parody of The Hunger Games film, that reimagines the high-stakes survival arena through a lighthearted, comical lens. By poking fun at iconic scenes, dramatic character tropes, and tense plot moments, this fan-made short delivers a humorous, fast-paced alternate version of the original story
response.tagline: The odds just got a lot dumber
response.title: The Hunger Games (But better)
